target.pattern: \b(?:grin and bear|grins and bears|grinned and bore|grinning and bearing) it\b

brief.meaningEn: Put up with something unpleasant without protesting, often trying to appear cheerful. The phrase can be used critically when a fair remedy is available.
brief.meaningZh: 對不愉快的事不作聲地忍受，往往還努力裝作若無其事；有合理補救途徑時，這種忍受未必必要。
brief.grammar: Grin and bear it is a coordinated verb idiom with fixed it referring to the unpleasant situation. In past tense, grinned and bore it.
brief.register: Informal conversational English. A class participant may use it when deciding whether to raise a service problem politely.
brief.boundaryZh: 適用於可辨認的不愉快情況與默默忍受；合理地提出問題不等於鬧事。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是鼓勵忍受危險或失當服務，也不表示真的一直在微笑。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分默默忍受、禮貌反映問題與公開吵鬧。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 170, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Customers need not grin and bear it when service fails.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: The pottery class lost its kiln for a second week, so students could not finish their pieces. Some planned to grin and bear it, but Mara politely asked for a revised date or refund instead.
listening.zh: 陶藝班連續第二週無法使用窯爐，學生不能完成作品。有人打算默默忍受，瑪拉則禮貌要求新日期或退款。
listening.promptZh: 瑪拉與打算默默忍受的同學有何不同？

options.en: She politely asked for a concrete remedy to the repeated problem.
options.zh: 她就反覆出現的問題禮貌要求具體補救。

options.en: She accepted the delay silently and made no request.
options.zh: 她默默接受延期，完全沒有提出要求。

options.en: She publicly shouted at every teacher.
options.zh: 她當眾向每位導師吼叫。

options.en: The kiln was working normally throughout.
options.zh: 窯爐一直運作正常。

listening.explanationZh: 她沒有強顏歡笑地忍受，也沒有吵鬧，而是提出具體合理要求。

reply.promptEn: The shared workshop has cancelled its repair session twice without offering a new date. Participants paid in advance, and the office accepts written requests. What can they do?
reply.promptZh: （共用工作坊兩度取消已付款的維修課，卻沒有提供新日期；辦公室接受書面查詢。參加者可怎樣處理？）

options.en: They can write to ask for a new date.
options.zh: 他們可寫信要求新日期。

options.en: They can request a refund if no session is available.
options.zh: 如果沒有補課，他們可要求退款。

options.en: They need not grin and bear it when a polite request can seek a remedy.
options.zh: 既可禮貌要求補救，他們便不必默默忍受。

options.en: They can explain the repeated cancellation in a factual message.
options.zh: 他們可在訊息中如實說明課堂兩度取消。

reply.explanationZh: 四句皆與可用的書面途徑和具體補救相符；金句對比默默忍受。

scene.promptZh: 社區合唱班連續三次遲開四十分鐘，學員可透過正式回饋表要求調整，卻有人說只好裝作沒事。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Members need not grin and bear it; they can submit a calm request for a reliable start time.
options.zh: 學員不必強顏歡笑地忍受，可平靜要求準時開課。

options.en: Members must shout at the conductor in public.
options.zh: 學員必須當眾向指揮吼叫。

options.en: One late start proves no remedy can ever work.
options.zh: 只要遲開一次，便證明任何補救都不會奏效。

scene.explanationZh: 反覆問題與正式途徑使默默忍受並非唯一選擇。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種情況最不足以說 someone had to grin and bear it？

options.en: The person is content with the arrangement and experiences no inconvenience.
options.zh: 那人滿意安排，完全沒有不便。

options.en: The person feels upset about repeated delays but says nothing.
options.zh: 那人因反覆延期而不快，卻甚麼都不說。

options.en: The person tolerates a noisy venue with a fixed smile while wanting a quieter place.
options.zh: 那人想換安靜場地，卻仍帶着勉強笑容忍受噪音。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有不快或不便，便談不上忍受。

dialogue.promptEn: A: The online course has missed three scheduled tutorials. The provider has a written complaints route, but I do not want to sound rude. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：網上課程有三次預定導修都沒有舉行。供應者有書面投訴途徑，但我不想顯得無禮。乙：______）

options.en: You do not have to grin and bear it; a factual, polite request is reasonable.
options.zh: 你不必強顏歡笑地忍受；如實而有禮地提出要求很合理。

options.en: You could list the three missed tutorials in your message.
options.zh: 你可在訊息列出三次未舉行的導修。

options.en: Asking for a make-up date does not have to be rude.
options.zh: 要求補課日期不一定無禮。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句分清默默忍受與有禮反映。

speaking.en: When the community shuttle skipped the accessible stop twice, riders did not have to grin and bear it; they recorded the dates and asked the operator to restore the published route.
speaking.zh: 社區穿梭巴士兩度跳過無障礙車站，乘客不必默默忍受；他們記下日期，要求營運者恢復公布的路線。
speaking.promptZh: 交代具體不便，以及不靠吵鬧的合理申訴途徑。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩組人遇到反覆而有記錄的不便，原本想默默忍受，後來提出有禮而具體的改善要求。用英文寫出問題和途徑。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例須有真實不便與可行申訴；不要把合理反映寫成公開吵鬧。

examples.en: After the library lift broke down for several mornings, wheelchair users chose not to grin and bear it; they logged the closures and asked for a temporary accessible route.
examples.zh: 圖書館升降機連續多個早上故障後，輪椅使用者沒有默默忍受；他們記下封閉情況，要求臨時無障礙路線。

examples.en: The market’s parcel counter lost two prepaid orders, so customers refused to grin and bear it and sent receipt copies to request replacements.
examples.zh: 市集包裹櫃位遺失兩件預付訂單，顧客沒有默默忍受，而是送交收據副本要求補貨。

takeaways.en: Grin and bear it describes silent tolerance of an unpleasant situation.
takeaways.zh: grin and bear it 描述對不愉快情況的默默忍受。

takeaways.en: You need not grin and bear it when a fair, polite remedy is available.
takeaways.zh: 有公平而禮貌的補救途徑時，你不必默默忍受。

brief.meaningEn: Cause a conspicuous public disturbance, often through loud anger or argument; a calm complaint does not count.
brief.meaningZh: 通常因大聲發怒或爭吵而造成引人注目的公開騷動；平靜反映問題不算。
brief.grammar: Make a scene is a verb idiom; make inflects. It commonly appears in negative advice not to make a scene. The scene is figurative public commotion.
brief.register: Informal conversational English. A friend may use it when suggesting a private way to resolve an event error.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有公開、顯眼的騷動；只是提出異議或私下反映，不等於鬧場。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是拍攝戲劇場面，也不能用來阻止合理投訴。
brief.outcomeZh: 能辨認公開吵鬧與有禮處理問題的差別。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 170, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: She did not want to make a scene at the counter.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: At the youth concert, Ben found his reserved seat had been given to someone else. He was upset, but he did not make a scene in front of the audience. He spoke quietly to an usher, who found another seat and corrected the list.
listening.zh: 在青年音樂會，本發現預留座位已給了別人。他很不快，但沒有在觀眾面前鬧場；他平靜地跟帶位員說明，對方找到另一座位並修正名單。

options.en: He raised it quietly with an usher instead of causing a public disturbance.
options.zh: 他平靜地向帶位員反映，沒有造成公開騷動。

options.en: He shouted at the audience until the concert stopped.
options.zh: 他向觀眾吼叫，直至音樂會停下。

options.en: He accepted the error without telling anyone.
options.zh: 他沒有告訴任何人，只接受錯誤。

options.en: He filmed a dramatic stage scene.
options.zh: 他拍攝了一幕戲劇場面。

listening.explanationZh: 平靜反映座位錯誤不是當眾鬧場。

reply.promptEn: A workshop organiser has put the wrong name on a certificate. The learner wants it corrected, and the desk can fix it after the session. What should the learner avoid doing in front of the audience?
reply.promptZh: （工作坊主辦者把證書上的姓名印錯。學員想更正，服務台可在課後處理。學員在觀眾面前應避免做甚麼？）

options.en: They should avoid shouting across the room about the mistake.
options.zh: 他們應避免隔着房間大聲吵嚷錯誤。

options.en: They can ask the desk for a correction after the session.
options.zh: 他們可在課後向服務台要求更正。

options.en: They do not need to make a scene to get the certificate fixed.
options.zh: 要修正證書，他們不必當眾鬧場。

options.en: A quiet request can still address the error.
options.zh: 平靜提出要求仍能處理錯誤。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指向不必公開吵鬧；金句用目標語區分爭取更正與鬧場。

scene.promptZh: 參觀者發現展覽門票日期印錯；她站在人群中大聲指責每位職員，令導賞停下。哪句最貼切？

options.en: She made a scene in front of the visitors instead of speaking to the desk quietly.
options.zh: 她在訪客面前鬧場，沒有平靜地找服務台處理。

options.en: She merely asked a private, calm question.
options.zh: 她只是私下平靜地問一個問題。

options.en: She created a theatre performance as part of the tour.
options.zh: 她在導賞中創作一齣戲劇表演。

scene.explanationZh: 高聲指責令活動中斷，符合公開騷動。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種情況最不足以說 make a scene？

options.en: A participant calmly asks a clerk in private to correct a name.
options.zh: 參加者私下平靜請職員更正姓名。

options.en: A guest yells at staff in a crowded lobby until the event stops.
options.zh: 賓客在擠滿人的大堂對職員吼叫，令活動停頓。

options.en: Someone loudly argues over a seat while others turn to watch.
options.zh: 有人為座位大聲爭吵，引得旁人回頭看。

contrast.explanationZh: 私下有禮提出問題，並無公開騷動。

dialogue.promptEn: A: The gallery sent us the wrong entry time. I want it corrected, but the opening talk has already begun. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：畫廊給我們的入場時間錯了。我想更正，但開幕講座已開始。乙：______）

options.en: We can speak to the desk afterward rather than make a scene during the talk.
options.zh: 我們可在講座後找服務台，而不是在場內鬧場。

options.en: Keeping the talk uninterrupted is considerate of other visitors.
options.zh: 不打斷講座是體諒其他訪客。

options.en: We can still ask for a correction in a calm way.
options.zh: 我們仍可平靜地要求更正。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句不放棄合理更正，但避免在講座中公開吵鬧。

speaking.en: The coach noticed the scoreboard was wrong, yet chose not to make a scene during the awards; she recorded the result and asked officials for a correction after the ceremony.
speaking.zh: 教練發現記分牌錯誤，卻選擇不在頒獎時鬧場；她記下結果，典禮後再向工作人員要求更正。
speaking.promptZh: 指出公開活動、可能的騷動，以及平靜處理方法。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩人遇到真實錯誤，原可當眾吵鬧，卻選擇有禮的補救方法。用英文寫出公開場合與處理步驟。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例須區分公開吵鬧和合理申訴；不能把所有投訴都說成鬧場。

examples.en: When the museum listed the wrong artist, Mina avoided making a scene at the crowded opening and emailed the curator a photograph of the correct label.
examples.zh: 博物館列錯藝術家時，米娜沒有在擠滿人的開幕禮鬧場，而是電郵策展人，附上正確標籤的照片。

examples.en: The parent did not make a scene at the school fair when a stall overcharged them; they kept the receipt and requested a refund from the organiser afterward.
examples.zh: 學校嘉年華的攤位多收費時，家長沒有當眾鬧場；他們保留收據，事後向主辦者要求退款。

takeaways.en: Make a scene means create a conspicuous public disturbance.
takeaways.zh: make a scene 指造成顯眼的公開騷動。

takeaways.en: You can avoid making a scene and still ask for a correction.
takeaways.zh: 你可避免當眾鬧場，同時要求更正。
